async def map_with_concurrency(items, width, operation, *, limit=None):
    pass


# CASE result_limit_named expect=pass
async def c1(items, op):
    await map_with_concurrency(items, 8, op, limit=1)


# CASE literal_one expect=fire
async def c2(items, op):
    await map_with_concurrency(items, 1, op)


# CASE width_name_expression expect=pass
async def c3(items, op, n):
    await map_with_concurrency(items, width=n or 1, operation=op)
